# Liam Huang — Developer

> Freelance web designer and front-end developer building fast, minimal, high-performance websites with semantic HTML, structured CSS, and modern vanilla JavaScript. No frameworks, no cookies, no analytics, no advertising — nothing about visitors is tracked.

## Pages

- [Home](https://liamhuang.dev/): Portfolio introduction with five short sections describing services and availability, selected work (three placeholders), plus a contact form.
- [Privacy Policy](https://liamhuang.dev/privacy.html): Data handling practices. The only data collected is what a visitor voluntarily sends through the contact form (name, email, message); it is never sold or shared. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts.

## Services

- Freelance web design with a focus on high-performance user interfaces
- Semantic HTML, structured CSS, and modern JavaScript without unnecessary frameworks
- Bridging visual design and fluid interaction: pixel-perfect execution, intuitive navigation, cross-browser compatibility
- Full frontend process: layout prototyping through production deployment, performance optimization, legacy UI modernization, stable frame rates during animation
- Currently available for freelance contracts, custom UI design, and front-end development partnerships
